prompt: Which architect designed the old post office at the corner of Jacques-Cartier and Saint-Jacques streets in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, which was completed in 1909?
answer: The old post office was designed by **Joseph-E.-Alexandre (J. E. H.) Benoît**, a local architect from Saint-Jean.
